summary: Iter5 retest of the two iter4 frontend bugs in /messages (InboxPage). Both fixes verified on desktop 1400x900 with homeowner@test.com.
verified_fixes: contact-action-row now contains 4 buttons on desktop: contact-call-btn (Call), contact-whatsapp-btn (WhatsApp), contact-share-location-btn (Share Location with Pro), contact-view-profile-btn (View profile). All four are visible at viewport 1400x900 (no sm:hidden).

Clicking [data-testid=contact-view-profile-btn] navigates from /messages to /pros/<pro_user_id> (verified: /pros/6a14b72e05a5dee99e39fd15) within 3s using SPA pushState. openProProfile fallback to activeThread.other_user_id works.
Clicking [data-testid=header-view-profile] in the inbox header also navigates to /pros/<pro_user_id> within ~3s.

Pro profile page renders the new layout: header card (Weber Installations, Verified/Licensed/Insured), Portfolio section, Reviews section, Weekly availability grid, 'At a glance' sidebar (Hourly rate, Experience, Jobs completed, Response), and Request quote CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor flakiness observed: a Playwright click with force=True on [data-testid=header-view-profile] occasionally did not trigger navigation within 5s on the very first attempt after thread load, while a plain (non-forced) click navigates reliably. This is a test-side artifact (force bypasses actionability checks before React state is fully wired); the production button itself works correctly for real users. No code change needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iter4 bugs are confirmed fixed in /app/frontend/src/pages/shared/InboxPage.jsx. openProProfile uses (otherUser?.id || activeThread?.other_user_id) and the action-row View Profile button no longer has sm:hidden so it appears on desktop. Tested at viewport 1400x900 only; mobile not retested but the change only made it more visible on desktop. If retesting, prefer plain `locator.click()` over `force=True` to avoid timing flakiness on the header button.
rca of the issue: Iter4 root cause: (1) openProProfile relied solely on contactInfo.pro.id which is null before the thread's /api/messages/thread/... contact unlock API completes; switching to activeThread.other_user_id as a fallback resolves it. (2) The action-row View Profile button had a `sm:hidden`/responsive class that hid it on desktop; removing that class makes it always visible. Both verified in current InboxPage.jsx lines 190-194 (openProProfile) and 353-361 (button).
